title: Go inside the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max!
text:
Daniel Nenni
Founder
Staff member

See what is really inside.

Join TechInsights experts for an evidence-based examination of the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max. The session will combine preliminary Quick Turn Teardown findings with semiconductor reverse engineering, component identification, early device costing, and smartphone market intelligence.

Explore the A20 Pro processor, Apple C2 modem, evolving camera and RF architectures, memory and storage configurations, semiconductor packaging, thermal management, and the component and supplier choices inside Apple’s newest Pro models.

Webinar: Inside the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max | TechInsights

Join TechInsights on October 14 for preliminary iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max teardown findings covering the A20 Pro, cameras, connectivity, memory, suppliers, packaging, and device cost.
